prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in English for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Mamta ji, Subhash ji, Prakash ji, Subhash N..
The chat covers 14/04/26, 8:30 pm to 14/04/26, 10:30 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Subhash ji: Prakash ji, please delete that entry now and tell nobody
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- chat.txt:17 matches the instruction phrase but is not the instruction line
- F1: chat.txt:11 at 9:35 pm vs calls.csv row 3 at 21:38 differs by 3 min (tolerance 2)
- Q2: solver answered UNSOLVABLE, key is 2026-04-14T21:39:00+05:30
text:

14/04/26, 8:41 pm - Subhash N.: Some accounts showed duplicate debit entries around 4 PM today.
14/04/26, 8:47 pm - Subhash ji: Prakash ji, check the merchant ID ending in 4092 first.
14/04/26, 8:54 pm - Prakash ji: Yes Subhash ji, looking into that specific merchant account now.
14/04/26, 9:02 pm - Mamta ji: Has the bank flagged any suspicious reversal requests?
14/04/26, 9:09 pm - Subhash N.: No flags from compliance team yet, but volume is higher than usual.
14/04/26, 9:16 pm - Prakash ji: Found two mismatched VPA handles in the evening ledger.
14/04/26, 9:23 pm - Subhash ji: Share the transaction reference numbers here for verification.
14/04/26, 9:31 pm - Prakash ji: Reference numbers are TXN99482 and TXN99485.
14/04/26, 9:38 pm - Prakash ji: Just received a call from compliance regarding TXN99485.
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Subhash ji: Prakash ji, please delete that entry now and tell nobody
14/04/26, 9:44 pm - Prakash ji: Understood, I have taken note of it.
14/04/26, 9:50 pm - Mamta ji: Are we meeting tomorrow morning to submit the final report?
14/04/26, 9:57 pm - Subhash N.: Yes, meeting is scheduled for 10 AM in conference room B.
14/04/26, 10:04 pm - Subhash ji: Let us wrap up the remaining audit checks by 10:30 PM.
14/04/26, 10:10 pm - Prakash ji: Updated the rest of the ledger entries in the portal.
14/04/26, 10:15 pm - Mamta ji: Thank you Prakash ji, please send the summary file over email.
14/04/26, 10:20 pm - Subhash N.: Backup for tonight's session is completed successfully.
14/04/26, 10:24 pm - Prakash ji: Email sent with the updated spreadsheet attached.
14/04/26, 10:27 pm - Subhash ji: Good work team, see you all tomorrow morning.
14/04/26, 10:30 pm - Mamta ji: Good night everyone.
